title: fix: validate message creation payload with Zod schema
head: xiaofengzii:fix/message-validation-5755
body:
## Summary
This PR adds Zod schema validation for message creation payloads.

## Changes
- Add `createMessageSchema` in `apps/api/src/validators/message.js` accepting only `content`, `recipientId`, and `jobId`
- Validate payload in `messageController.js` and return 400 for invalid payloads
- System fields (id, sentAt) are server-assigned
- Add tests for valid input, missing fields, extra fields, and empty content

## Testing
- All tests pass: `node --test src/tests/message.test.js`

/claim #743
Closes #5755
